chunks: Al-Hasan b. Muhammad b. Sa'id al-Hashimi narrated to us. He said: Furat b. Ibrahim b. Furat al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Zhahir narrated to us. He said: 'Abdullah b. al-Fadl al-Hashimi narrated to us from al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad, from his father, from his forefathers (peace be upon them). He said: The Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family) said:

The day of Ghadir Khumm is the greatest of the Eids of my Nation. It is the day in which God the Exalted commanded me to appoint my brother 'Ali b. Abi Talib as a sign for my Nation to be guided by after me. And it is the day in which God completed the religion, fulfilled the blessing upon my Nation, and chose Islam as their religion.

Then he (may God bless him and his family) said: O people! 'Ali is from me and I am from 'Ali. He was created from my clay, and he is the Imam of creation after me. He will clarify for them what they differ regarding my Sunna. He is the Commander of the Faithful, the Leader of the shining marked believers, the ruler of the believers, the best of deputies, the husband of the Mistress of the Women of the Worlds, and the father of the Guided Imams.

O people! Whoever loves 'Ali, I love him; whoever hates 'Ali, I hate him; whoever connects with 'Ali, I connect with him; whoever cuts off 'Ali, I cut him off; whoever is aloof to 'Ali, I am aloof to him; whoever aligns with 'Ali, I align with him; and whoever opposes 'Ali, I oppose him.
O people! I am the City of Wisdom and 'Ali b. Abi Talib is its gate - no one can come to the City except through the Gate. And whoever alleges that he loves me yet hates 'Ali has lied.

O people! By He who raised me with prophethood and selected me over all creation: I did not establish 'Ali as a sign for my Nation in the Earth until God proclaimed his name in His heavens and made his wilaya obligatory for His angels.

key_terms.أمير المؤمنين: Commander of the Faithful (Amir al-Mu'minin) — the principal title of Imam 'Ali
key_terms.غدير خم: Ghadir Khumm — a location between Mecca and Medina where the Prophet delivered a sermon on 18 Dhul Hijja appointing Imam 'Ali as his successor
key_terms.مدينة الحكمة: City of Wisdom — a title the Prophet gave himself, with 'Ali as its gate
key_terms.ولاية: Wilaya — guardianship, authority; God made 'Ali's wilaya obligatory even for the angels

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about Imam Ali at Ghadir Khumm?
ai.summary: In this famous sermon delivered at Ghadir Khumm on the 18th of Dhul Hijja, the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) declares the day of Ghadir the greatest Eid for his nation, connecting it to the Quranic verse of the completion of religion (5:3). He enumerates the titles and virtues of Imam 'Ali (AS), establishes a series of parallel declarations linking love and enmity toward 'Ali to love and enmity toward the Prophet, and declares himself the City of Wisdom with 'Ali as its gate.
